title: Recorded report server lifecycle
responsibility: Stores a server’s process identity and stops only the process matching that recorded identity.

inputs.name: processStarted.pid
inputs.description: Process identifier whose system start time is requested.

inputs.name: reportServerRecord.root
inputs.description: Report store root used for server records.

inputs.name: stopReportServer.root
inputs.description: Report store root whose recorded server should be stopped.

inputs.name: stopReportServer.port
inputs.description: Port identifying the recorded server to stop.

outputs.name: processStarted
outputs.description: Trimmed system start-time text from ps for that PID, or undefined when the command fails or returns no value.

outputs.name: reportServerRecord
outputs.description: Record file path plus async read, write and remove methods. Reads suppress filesystem failures as absence, but malformed JSON rejects; writes create the server-record directory.

outputs.name: stopReportServer
outputs.description: Loads the record, compares PID and start time, sends SIGTERM only to a match, waits in roughly 100-millisecond intervals for up to five seconds, then sends SIGKILL if the same process remains. Removes the record and reports whether a matching process was initially found.
